as_told.title: Charles Fort's Book of the Damned: we are property

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that the first person to think this way about UFOs was Charles Fort, a writer who collected reports of strange events, back in the 1920s. The idea Jorjani credits to Fort is that humans are property, owned by someone else the way Britain ruled India, which would mean we are being managed by beings we cannot see.
